prompt: Draft a Python standard-library module for a foreman review of an overnight AI training schedule. It may validate JSON run entries, enforce unique run IDs, verify sorted checkpoint steps, require one authorization-file path per run, record per-run status, and write a human-readable summary. It must not execute shell commands, load models, open leases, authorize runs, train, retry, deploy, or mutate repository files. Return code only, preferably inside a Python code fence.
